<thought>We need to apply retrosynthetic template 29646 to the given target molecule to obtain all possible precursor combinations. Using the apply_template tool with the target SMILES and the template ID will return the precursor lists.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O", "template_id": "29646"}</action_input>
